reviews.text:
🎨 Review bảng mắt Romand Better Than Palette #07 Berry Fuchsia Garden (ngắn gọn – tiếng Anh)

The Romand #07 palette is a stunning cool-tone pink and purple set with strong pigmentation, smooth blending, and beautiful shimmer shades that make eye looks stand out. It’s perfect for bold or cool-tone makeup lovers, though some shades can be quite intense and there may be slight fallout with glitter. Overall, it’s a gorgeous palette that I really enjoy using.
reviews.zh:
🎨 Romand Better Than Palette #07 Berry Fuchsia Garden 眼影盤開箱（簡短 – 英文）

Romand #07 眼影盤係一盒超靚嘅冷調粉紫配色，顯色度強、容易推開，仲有靚到爆嘅閃片色，搞到個眼妝好突出。鍾意大膽妝感或者冷調妝嘅人啱晒用，不過有啲色會比較濃，閃片亦可能有少少飛粉。整體嚟講，係一盒好靚嘅眼影盤，我真係好鍾意用。

reviews.text: So the left side of my arm I used nyx eyeshadow primer. The right no primer. The glitter it so beautiful and it's just glitter no color and glitter if that makes sense in the picture with just my arm I was wiping with a makeup wipe lightly ( A few swipes) and that's what came off so if you use the right primer for you it has real lasting power. I've once wore this eyeshadow for 2.5 days. It's really nice. And so soft and beautiful it's my new favorite palette.
reviews.zh: 我左手臂嗰邊用咗 NYX 眼影打底霜，右手邊就冇用。閃片真係好靚，而且純粹係閃冇乜底色，希望我講嘅嘢大家睇圖就明。淨係手臂嗰張我已經用化妝棉輕輕抹咗幾下先至抹到咁多落嚟，所以如果揀到啱自己嘅打底霜，呢盤眼影嘅持久力真係掂。我試過 keep 住呢個眼妝 2.5 日。質地真係好正，又軟又靚，已經變咗我嘅新寵。

reviews.text: I like this palette despite its design for much more fair skinned people. I like the darkest shade to use lightly to do my contour. Its pigment is not as concentrated western brands because its meant for lighter skin tones, but the highlighter/glitter is really longlasting and a gorgeous sunset coral shade. Its colors are good for a natural eye makeup look and aren’t overpowering
reviews.zh: 雖然呢盒明顯係設計畀膚色再白啲嘅人用，但我都幾鍾意。最深嗰隻色我會輕輕用嚟打陰影。顯色度無西方品牌嗰啲咁濃，畢竟係為較淺膚色設計嘅，不過 highlight 同閃片嗰啲真係超持久，而且係一隻好靚嘅日落珊瑚色。呢盒嘅顏色用嚟化自然眼妝好啱，唔會太搶眼。

reviews.text: This palette is a good one for both warm and cool tone. I carry it in my travel bag too because it can be used as a whole face palette. The orchid night (5th on top row) shows up as a mauve purple on my skin so I use it as blush. The 3rd and 4th browns on the bottom row have a purple hue to them as well, so they don’t look muddy on the skin. I use them as nose and eye contour too. These colors are great for every day and they don’t make the face look dull. The glitters stick onto the skin and don’t flake off throughout the day. The peach glitter can be a highlighter and the white glitter is more chunky and really sparkles. Little goes a long way. The pigment is also very good.
reviews.zh: 呢盒眼影盤無論暖調定冷調都夾得到。我連出遠門都會帶埋佢，因為真係可以當成 full face 嚟用。Orchid Night（上排第 5 格）喺我皮膚上面出嚟係帶紫調嘅粉紅色，我會當胭脂用。下排第 3 同第 4 隻啡色都帶少少紫調，所以上臉唔會顯得污糟，我會用嚟做鼻影同眼窩陰影。呢啲色日日用都好啱，又唔會令塊面望落暗沉。閃片黐住皮膚成日都唔甩，peach 嗰隻可以用嚟做 highlight，白色嗰隻就粒粒大啲、閃到爆。用少少已經好夠，顯色度都好高。

reviews.text: I bought this for the 2nd time as a gift! All the rom&nd eye shadow palette have such pretty colours! This Dusty Fog Garden palette is very versatile: you can wear it alone or layer it over other eyeshadow shades (which maybe too bright alone), to tone it down. The colours are very pretty and I really love how they are buildable and easy to blend. Just 1 layer if you want something light and you can add more layers if you want a more pigmented look, highly suitable for daily/office use. Can be easily applied using just fingers as the powder is very fine.
reviews.zh: 買咗第二次送畀人做禮物！Rom&nd 嘅眼影盤隻隻顏色都超靚！呢盒 Dusty Fog Garden 真係好百搭：可以單用，又可以疊喺其他眼影上面（如果有啲眼影單用太搶），用嚟中和返就啱晒。顏色真係好靚，我好鍾意佢可以層層疊加，而且容易推開。想淡妝就一層，要顯色啲就加多幾層，好適合返工或者日常用。粉末好幼，淨用手指都上到。

reviews.text:
So pretty!! I purchased 03 Rosebud Garden because a lot of Korean makeup shops and artists used this palette
I do not regret it whatsoever it’s so pretty!!
I have the Clio pro eye palette in simply pink 
It’s similar to that palette however the rom&nd palette is a bit more warm than the Clio one. 
But other than that they are similar I don’t necessarily think you need both unless you’re an absolute makeup lover like me hehe
But I don’t think you need both, just choose one that fits your taste more 
Clio- cool toned and a tad toned down pink palette 
Rom&nd- slightly warmer toned but still cool toned pink palette
reviews.zh:
超靚呀！！好多韓國化妝舖同化妝師都有用呢盒，所以我買咗 03 Rosebud Garden
完全冇後悔，超靚呀！！
我有 Clio pro eye palette simply pink
同呢盒有少少似，不過 rom&nd 呢盒暖少少。
但除咗呢點其他都好似，除非你好似我咁係化妝痴，否則唔一定要兩盒都買
不過我覺得唔需要兩盒，揀返最啱自己嗰盒就得
Clio – 冷調粉調，比較淡
Rom&nd – 暖少少但都仲係冷調粉調

reviews.text:
I’m on the fence about this purchase. I bought shade and shadow garden this time after buying mahogany garden last time, which I love. 

I honestly bought the palette because it was so pretty to look at. But the shades are really delicate and powdery so if you go a bit overboard my lids start looking “Cakey”. 

They’re a great daily go to if you’re going for the toned down, no makeup makeup look for people with more pale skin. 

I’m warm toned so these colors don’t really stand out very well on my skin. Very subtle. 

Added some other daily palettes for comparison.
reviews.zh:
我對呢次買嘢半信半疑。上次買咗 Mahogany Garden 我好鍾意，今次就買咗 Shade and Shadow Garden。

講真，我買佢純粹係因為望落好靚。但係啲色好幼好鬆散，畫得重手少少眼皮就會變到「一撻撻」。

如果鍾意清淡裸妝感、膚色偏白嘅人，呢盒真係日常好幫手。

我自己係暖調膚色，呢啲色喺我塊面上唔算好突出，好淡好淡。

加咗幾盒其他日常眼影盤做對比。

reviews.text: I waited so long for this palette and I love it! It is a really good everyday brown palette that is not too red or too yellow, just the perfect brown. The glitters are pretty but I don't know how often I would use them because they're all quite "glittery" and loud. The larger glitters are a bit more finicky though since the glitter pieces are so large. I also added a comparison picture of some other brown palettes.
reviews.zh: 等咗呢盒好耐終於到手，好鍾意！真係一盒好正嘅日常啡色眼影盤，唔會太紅又唔會太黃，啱啱好嘅啡色。閃片都幾靚，不過我就唔知自己會幾常用，因為全部都幾「閃」幾搶眼。大粒嘅閃片比較難搞，因為閃片粒粒太大。我亦加咗一張同其他啡色眼影盤嘅比較圖。
